name: astra-ux
oneLiner: Capture the owner's user journeys UJ-n and actors into the PRD before any spec is written.

name: astra-grill-with-docs
oneLiner: Stress-test a plan with the owner in rounds of numbered questions until the design tree has no unvisited branch.

name: astra-to-spec
oneLiner: Turn the answered Align frontier and the code into a spec published to the tracker.

name: astra-to-tickets
oneLiner: Cut a committed spec into tracer-bullet tickets with prerequisite edges, published in build order.

name: test-design
oneLiner: Write the risk-ranked QA plan docs/qa/plan-<slug>.md before the tickets are cut.

name: astra-implement-with-tdd
oneLiner: Build one ticket test-first: one failing test per criterion before the code that passes it.

name: astra-ui
oneLiner: A UI pass on one rendered surface against DESIGN.md and the ticket's Glance and States: audit, polish or upgrade.

name: astra-review
oneLiner: Review a change on three axes in separate contexts, verify each finding at its line, give one verdict, route it.

name: codex-arm
oneLiner: The cross-vendor arm: a direct read-only codex exec with an Astragentic lens over a finished artifact.

name: dispatch-ticket
oneLiner: Dispatch one claimed ticket as a visible pane on Herdr or Orca: one Builder, one worktree, one branch.

name: dispatch-ticket-claude
oneLiner: Claude Code launcher, dispatch mod behaviour and pre-dispatch checks for a dispatched pane.

name: dispatch-qa-walk
oneLiner: Thomas-only recipe to dispatch QA's walk of the running product before merge.

name: dispatch-junior
oneLiner: Builder-only recipe to hand a ticket's implementation to a junior pane on another runtime (Grok first) and take the tree back for review.

name: astragentic-dispatch
oneLiner: The Claude Code mod: a dispatched pane records itself, runs its brief as a user turn and reports its turn end.

name: github-issue-tracker
oneLiner: Operating mechanics for a project whose tracker is GitHub Issues — status as labels, the claim, native dependencies keyed by database id, the frontier loop, and the Projects board mirror.

name: jira-issue-tracker
oneLiner: Operating mechanics for a project whose tracker is Jira — status as numbered transitions, cloudId and JQL quoting, issue links and their invertible direction, whole-field description writes, and what only a human can change.

name: linear-issue-tracker
oneLiner: Operating mechanics for a project whose tracker is Linear — native states and relations, the claim protocol where assignee cannot hold a Builder identity, wayfinding primitives, and the free-tier issue ceiling that stops a pipeline outright.

name: reconcile-tracker
oneLiner: Reconcile the tracker against git — detect tickets whose recorded state contradicts what actually merged, plus stale claims.

name: astragentic-update-install
oneLiner: Check the installed version, or stage and adapt a release in the current project.

name: builder
oneLiner: Builds one ticket in its own worktree as the sole writer there.

name: qa
oneLiner: Product-quality walker.

name: shaper
oneLiner: Shaping session.

name: thomas
oneLiner: Router.

name: ba
oneLiner: Sits in the user's seat, read-only: clarifies the problem, walks the running product, hands off a markdown file or a ticket.

name: quick-builder
oneLiner: Small owner-asked changes on an ops/* branch, no ticket.
